intended_object: This is the action on arrows of the functor `toNative`, from the integral full subcategory of `DenseOpenRationalScheme` to `IntegralDominantRationalScheme`. It takes a dense-open-pulling rational map between integral schemes and returns the same rational map, packaged as a dominant arrow. Inferred from the docstring and from its only use, as `map` in `toNative`.
explanation: This is a repackaging step, not a mathematical object in its own right. The definition takes the underlying quotient rational map `toRationalMap f`. It then uses the library lemma `pullsDenseOpens_iff_isDominant` to turn the "pulls dense opens" proof stored in `f` into a proof that the map is dominant. Mathematically it is the identity on rational maps. It moves an arrow from one of the library's own encodings of "dominant rational maps between integral schemes" to the other. Its job is to supply the `map` field of the functor `toNative`, which is one half of the equivalence `integralDenseOpenEquivalence`. Nothing here corresponds to a separate notion in the literature, and so nothing could be stated too narrowly or incorrectly. The construction is consistent with its docstring: it keeps the underlying rational map, which the `rfl` lemma `nativeHom_toRationalMap` confirms.
